title: Lemon Tang (Korean Ver.)
statementMd:
Inspired by her group's new song, Stella decides to treat her friends to dessert! They have a lineup of n lemon cheesecakes, where the ith one has sweetness ai. All the members plan to share the cheesecakes, but unfortunately Jiwoo despises sour tastes.

Luckily Stella has k spoonfuls of syrup, which she can apply to the cheesecakes as she wishes. For instance, she could choose to use all the syrup on a single cheesecake, or disperse such that each cake gets one spoon. Adding a spoon of syrup increases a cake's sweetness by +1. Jiwoo's *score* for the lineup is the smallest sweetness across all the cheesecakes.

Can you help Stella maximize Jiwoo's score?

## Input

The first line contains two integers n and k (1≤n,k≤2⋅105), denoting the number of cheesecakes and the number of spoons of syrup.

The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the array a, where ai denotes the sweetness of the ith cake (1≤ai≤109).

## Output

Output a single integer, denoting the maximum value for miniai after using the syrup optimally.

## Note

In the sample, it is possible to transform [3,1,4,2] to [4,4,4,3], which gives a minimum value of 3. It can be shown it is not possible to do better.

It may help to listen to the following song: [https://open.spotify.com/track/0NGFAcYQVHCIdQea2qSs1I?si=fdd91b739c0c4549](https://open.spotify.com/track/0NGFAcYQVHCIdQea2qSs1I?si=fdd91b739c0c4549)
